# The Child Lens

> A platform for systemic change in children's health, based in Barcelona. We build ventures from scratch, walk hand-in-hand with startups, and shift the perspectives of those in power.

The Child Lens works across the seams of children's health — where funding gaps, power dynamics and cultural blind spots quietly shape outcomes. We turn isolated efforts into a shared path so progress moves further, faster, together.

## Three Ways of Working

- **The Builder**: We turn your science into a paediatric venture, step by step — from value proposition to fundable story.
- **The Right Hand**: We act as your right hand in paediatric innovation, bringing clarity, focus, and momentum.
- **The Voice**: We engage directly with policymakers, hospital leaders, and funders to shift how decisions are made.

## Team

- [Pilar Puig — Founder](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pilar-puig-sarries-phd/): Building paediatric ventures and driving systemic innovation in children's health.
- [Tanya Humphreys — Associate](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tanyahumphreys/): Brings expertise in impact investing, venture building and partnerships.
- [Marc Ramis — Advisor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markramis/): Brings expertise in strategy and company building.

## Trusted Experts

- **Esther Riambau, PhD**: Tech Transfer & Company Creation. Translates scientific discoveries into venture-ready companies, including in paediatric oncology.
- **Jair Barril**: Hospital Innovation Adoption and AI Systems. Drives adoption of paediatric technologies and digital health products, and leads AI-driven automation within hospital processes at Boston Children's Hospital.
- **Maria Sanchís, PhD**: Hospital Innovation Adoption. Links solution providers and hospital functional teams to enable adoption of innovative technologies in clinical environments.
- **Mark Sorrentino, MD**: VP Pediatric Clinical Development, ICON. Leads ICON's global pediatric center of excellence, shaping clinical strategy and trial design across paediatric populations.
- **Tito Español**: AI & Digital Products. Designs and develops digital health products, from early concept to scalable product.
